_source: Admin API, 2026-08-30. The Storefront token in data.mjs has no `unauthenticated_read_content` scope, so unlike catalogue.json this cache cannot refresh itself. Re-pull with: query { blog(id: "gid://shopify/Blog/90750779554") { articles(first: 50) { nodes { id title handle publishedAt summary tags author { name } image { url altText width height } metafields(first: 20) { nodes { namespace key value } } } } } }
_notes: `content` is not cached: the journal index does not read it, and the 19 bodies are ~60 KB. Add them here if the /blogs/news/:handle route is ported.

Every article on the live store has ZERO metafields and no image. The `custom.read_time` values below are NOT in Shopify yet -- they are the hand-authored readTime strings from src/data/seoContent.ts + seoJournal.extra.ts, which is the copy the store was seeded from. nf-journal.liquid falls back to a 200 wpm estimate off the body when the metafield is absent, and that estimate does not reproduce these numbers (the source values run 44-73 words/min, they were written, not computed). Seeding these 19 metafields on the store is a content change, which HANDOFF.md puts out of scope without approval.
